source.title: Competitor started a Multiblind attempt without a judge present
source.content:
A competitor began their 3x3x3 Multi-blind attempt without a judge present, assuming they could start with a stackmat timer due to the use of floating judges. Realizing their mistake, the competitor asked if their attempt should be a DNF. When the delegate told them that this was the case they stopped their attempt. After reconsideration however, the delegates provided a provisional extra attempt.

The WRC clarified that starting a blindfolded attempt without a judge violates regulation [B2a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#B2a), which states that a judge must be present at the start of each attempt. Furthermore, a stopwatch should have been started as required by Regulation [A1b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#A1b) since the time limit was over 10 minutes. Since the competitor's actions prevented proper judging, the WRC ruled that the original attempt should be disqualified (DNF).

translation.title: 无裁判在场时开始多盲
translation.content:
一名选手认为采用流动裁判时可以用 Stackmat 自行开始，于是在没有裁判在场的情况下开始三阶多盲。意识到错误后，他询问是否应判 DNF。代表说是，他便停止。代表重新考虑后又给予暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 澄清，无裁判在场便开始盲拧违反 [B2a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#B2a)，该条要求每次尝试开始时必须有裁判。此外，时限超过 10 分钟，按 [A1b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#A1b) 也应启动秒表。选手行为使正常执裁无法进行，因此 WRC 判原尝试 DNF。
